phase: Phase 5: Audio Codec Optimization, Jitter Buffering & Packet Loss Concealment (PLC)

stories.title: Adaptive Jitter Buffer & Playout Sequencer
stories.description: Implement AdaptiveJitterBuffer in commonMain to sequence incoming packets, estimate network jitter, handle out-of-order frames, and output frames at steady playout deadlines.
acceptanceCriteria: Sequences incoming packets by sequence number and drops stale arrivals past playout deadline
Dynamically calculates inter-arrival jitter variance and adapts target delay (40ms-120ms)
Emits missing frame signal when a frame gap occurs at playout deadline
100% multiplatform test pass in commonTest

stories.title: Packet Loss Concealment (PLC) & Frame Interpolator
stories.description: Implement PacketLossConcealment in commonMain using pitch-synchronous waveform extrapolation and exponential decay to conceal dropped mesh frames.
acceptanceCriteria: Synthesizes replacement audio frame from previous valid frame pitch period
Applies exponential energy attenuation (-3dB per consecutive lost frame)
Smooth cross-fade blending when normal packet stream resumes
100% multiplatform test pass in commonTest

stories.title: Adaptive Noise Gate & VOX Energy DSP
stories.description: Implement NoiseGate in commonMain with attack, hold, release envelope tracking and hysteresis to suppress ambient motorcycle wind noise.
acceptanceCriteria: Configurable attack (e.g. 5ms), hold (e.g. 100ms), and release (e.g. 50ms) time constants
Hysteresis threshold prevents chattering near threshold boundary
Smooth gain ramping avoids acoustic clicking on gate transitions
100% multiplatform test pass in commonTest

stories.title: Multi-Rate Pure KMP Audio Codec Engine
stories.description: Implement AudioCodec in commonMain providing high-efficiency audio compression matching AudioProfile rates (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, ULTRA) with zero C/JNI dependencies.
acceptanceCriteria: Compresses 20ms 24kHz/16kHz PCM frames into compact byte packets (40 to 160 bytes) fitting single BLE GATT MTU
Decodes compressed packets back to 16-bit PCM ShortArray with high SNR
100% pure Kotlin Multiplatform running across Android, iOS, JVM, and Wasm/JS
100% multiplatform test pass in commonTest

stories.title: Audio Pipeline End-to-End Integration & Benchmark Test
stories.description: Integrate AdaptiveJitterBuffer, PLC, NoiseGate, and AudioCodec into AudioEngine and run end-to-end multiplatform audio pipeline tests.
acceptanceCriteria: AudioEngine uses AudioCodec, JitterBuffer, and PLC in default processing loop
Integration test verifies continuous audio playout under 20% simulated packet loss and 50ms jitter
Zero regressions across entire test suite and platform builds
All Gradle verification gates pass cleanly
